svg.aria-label: ÉCLOS Refill bayonet collar: track, half-section and refill steps
svg.title: ÉCLOS Refill: bayonet collar mechanism
svg.desc: ÉCLOS Refill bayonet closure, drawn from the digital fit model. A: the neck track unwrapped and seen from outside: two entries 180° apart; each collar lug is lowered into its entry and turned 45° clockwise, seen from above, to the track end, which is the only stop; there is no detent. B: half-section of the closed assembly through a lug. The collar, Ø62 with a Ø44 aperture, holds the Ø49 cartridge shoulder down on the rim of the Ø54 neck, overlapping it by 2.5 mm radially. The skirt bore is Ø55, a 0.5 mm radial gap. The lug is 3 mm high in a 4 mm track, 0.5 mm clear above and below. The cartridge body, Ø40, sits in a Ø42 bore. 120 mm overall, vessel Ø58. Open issue: the shoulder has 0 clearance to the collar. C: to refill, turn the collar back 45°, lift it off, then lift out the cartridge. Model dimensions in mm of a digital fit study, not printed or tested.

g.text: MODEL DIMENSIONS IN MM · DIGITAL FIT STUDY · NOT PRINTED OR TESTED
